summary: Master the art of managing outsourcing and partnership agreements through our expert-led training course. Sign up today to elevate your career prospects.
lede: Managing Outsourcing and Partnership Agreements helps professionals make evidence-based outsourcing decisions, choose suitable partnership models, and establish clear scopes, deliverables, service levels, and responsibilities. It provides a practical approach to managing vendors and partners through performance reviews while keeping value, control, risk, and accountability in view. Learn how to handle underperformance, scope changes, disputes, and change requests without losing operational clarity. With templates, checklists, and practical scenarios, the course supports stronger agreements and safer exits when a relationship no longer serves its purpose.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals across various sectors who are responsible for managing outsourcing and partnerships.
audience: IT, facilities, logistics, and HR managers
modules: Outsourcing and Partnerships: What You Are Really Committing To
Selecting the Right Model and Vendor or Partner
Structuring the Agreement: Key Components That Protect You
Service Levels, KPIs, and Performance Management
Pricing, Payment Terms, and Value for Money Controls
Risk, Compliance, and Data Protection in Third-Party Relationships
Managing the Relationship: Governance That Works
Handling Underperformance, Disputes, and Relationship Breakdown
Change Management: Variations, Scope Creep, and Renegotiation
Contract Closeout, Renewal, and Exit Planning
prerequisites: Participants should have basic experience in procurement, contracting, or vendor management. Familiarity with organizational operations and project management is beneficial.
